svg.desc: scope: Inventory + sales: purchase receiving, POS, invoices, payments and stock movements. MVC and REST API share application services. inspect: SQL application locking, persisted retry keys, and role / ownership checks. tradeoff: Writes serialize for a small-business workload. No production deployment is claimed. stack: C# / ASP.NET Core MVC + Web API / EF Core / SQL Server / Bootstrap
